bug_semantics: When proxy authentication and a non-default auth.logoutPage were configured, the shared http/auth.go withUser middleware treated an expiration-only JWT validation error as renewable and continued with the user identity embedded in the expired token. Because that exception required only the token and configuration—not a current assertion from the trusted proxy—the expired token authenticated every withUser-protected route, including withAdmin routes, and /api/renew could exchange it for a fresh token indefinitely.
flaw_origin: The smallest source commit is PR #3884 member 07fe90ff5f093f7086fe0c811f9daba262c6b120. It added renewableErr and changed withUser's unconditional rejection of err != nil or !token.Valid into a conditional rejection that waived an expiration-only error for proxy auth plus a custom logout page. The helper received no request or asserted proxy identity, so it could not establish that the external proxy session was still active. GitHub later squash-landed the PR as b9ac45d5dac4b4eb2ba364629090fbf306cffd2b.
ai_marker: absent: the exact BIC commit object at https://api.github.com/repos/filebrowser/filebrowser/git/commits/07fe90ff5f093f7086fe0c811f9daba262c6b120 records author jake-dog <jake-dog@users.noreply.github.com> and committer jake-dog <jake-dog@users.noreply.github.com>; neither identity is a bot. Its complete message is 'allow renewal of token if its safe to do so when using proxy auth with custom login' and contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI, or other trailer/marker.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/filebrowser/filebrowser/security/advisories/GHSA-v3jv-rmh2-635j identifies http/auth.go renewableErr/withUser, the protected/admin/renew attack path, affected versions >=2.50.0 and <=2.63.21, patched v2.63.22, and official landing fix 72faf6dd3c85628e332d3e567124b86708ce2695. In the validated clone, `git log -L 68,102:http/auth.go 72faf6dd3c85628e332d3e567124b86708ce2695^` and `git log --all -S'renewableErr' -- http/auth.go` identify squash landing b9ac45d5dac4b4eb2ba364629090fbf306cffd2b as the mainline addition. First-party PR https://github.com/filebrowser/filebrowser/pull/3884 maps that merge_commit_sha to a reconstructable member history; member https://github.com/jake-dog/filebrowser/commit/07fe90ff5f093f7086fe0c811f9daba262c6b120 is the one-file +17/-1 change that first adds renewableErr and changes withUser to accept its exception. Direct-parent tree verification used https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jake-dog/filebrowser/8dd871df1793e0d481ad01e88f007b89929fc347/http/auth.go versus https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jake-dog/filebrowser/07fe90ff5f093f7086fe0c811f9daba262c6b120/http/auth.go: parent 8dd871df1793e0d481ad01e88f007b89929fc347 has no renewableErr and rejects every parse error or invalid token; child 07fe90ff5f093f7086fe0c811f9daba262c6b120 adds the vulnerable exception, proving parent absence. Release ancestry checks found the squash landing's first containing tag is v2.50.0; `git merge-base --is-ancestor b9ac45d5dac4b4eb2ba364629090fbf306cffd2b v2.49.0` failed while the same check against v2.50.0 succeeded. The official fix's first containing tag is v2.63.22; `git merge-base --is-ancestor 72faf6dd3c85628e332d3e567124b86708ce2695 v2.63.21` failed while the v2.63.22 check succeeded. First-party PR https://github.com/filebrowser/filebrowser/pull/6053 exposes the focused direct fix fe00ec45d55f2841d66d22c80f782f5609e1905b; https://github.com/filebrowser/filebrowser/commit/fe00ec45d55f2841d66d22c80f782f5609e1905b changes http/auth.go so renewableErr calls proxyAsserts with the request and token user ID, requiring the configured proxy header to resolve to that same user. That member was squash-landed in the advisory's official 72faf6dd3c85628e332d3e567124b86708ce2695, whose diff contains the same auth fix and regression coverage.
reasoning: The vulnerable behavior is not merely token renewal: withUser is the shared authentication gate, and once it ignores the expiration error it loads the user from expired claims and invokes the protected handler. withAdmin composes withUser, and renewHandler also composes withUser, producing both ongoing privileged access and indefinite refresh. Mainline history initially points to b9ac45d5dac4b4eb2ba364629090fbf306cffd2b, but that commit is the squash aggregate for PR #3884 and therefore is not the smallest BIC. Decomposing the public PR history isolates 07fe90ff5f093f7086fe0c811f9daba262c6b120: its direct parent still rejects all parse errors/invalid tokens, while the child alone writes the settings-only expiration waiver. The squash first appears in v2.50.0 and is absent from v2.49.0, matching the first-party affected lower boundary. The direct fix fe00ec45d55f2841d66d22c80f782f5609e1905b adds the missing current proxy-identity assertion; official squash landing 72faf6dd3c85628e332d3e567124b86708ce2695 is absent from v2.63.21 and present in patched v2.63.22. Finally, the exact 07fe90ff5f093f7086fe0c811f9daba262c6b120 commit object has human author/committer identities and no AI marker or trailer, so BIC-only attribution yields NOT_AI regardless of any signals outside that object.
